params.body:
## What this is

Text had size tokens but no roles: nothing said what a page title, the answer of a block or a label is, so every screen picked a size per element. `refresh.css` set a font size 501 times in 27 literal values from 8 to 34 px, `insights.css` 50 times in 11 values, and blades added sizes in brackets on top. A screen showed between 5 and 13 distinct text sizes.

This pull request adds the layer that was missing: a ladder of six sizes, twelve text roles defined once, a spacing scale with named gaps, three heights of shadow, three shared pieces for the top of a page, a reference page that reads every value from the stylesheets, a guide, and a test that fails the build on a size that is not a role.

No behaviour changes. No routes, no migrations, no PHP outside one read-only support class (`App\Support\DesignTokens`, which parses the stylesheets for the reference page).

## The ladder and the roles

Six sizes, picked by hand: **11, 13, 15, 18, 22, 26** px. Body text is 15. Each step is at least a seventh above the one below. There is no 12 and no 14: beside 13 or 15, one pixel reads as a slip and not as a rank. One line height per size, three weights (400, 500, 600).

| Role | Size/line, weight | Ink | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | 22/28, 600 | 1 | The name of the page, once per screen |
| `headline` | 22/28, 400 | 1 | The answer of a page as a sentence, its number in 600 |
| `figure` | 22/28, 600 | 1 | A figure that stands on its own over its label |
| `display` | 26/32, 600 | 1 | The one amount a screen exists for (the price of a car) |
| `lead` | 18/26, 400 | 1 | The answer of a block or a window, the question of a dialog |
| `section` | 15/22, 500 | 1 | The title of a card, a section of a form |
| `body` | 15/22, 400 | 1 | Text you read and values you compare |
| `label` | 13/20, 500 | 2 | The name of a field, a group or a block |
| `note` | 13/20, 400 | 3 | A column head, a help line, a source |
| `control` | 15/20, 500 | from the control | The word on a button, a tab, a menu item |
| `control-sm` | 13/20, 500 | from the control | A button in a row, a chip, a badge, a segment |
| `micro` | 11/16, 500 | 3 | A count in a bubble, an axis tick, a monogram; never a sentence |

A role is one declaration in a stylesheet (`font: var(--ui-role-note)`), one class in a view (`ui-text-note`), or one Tailwind name where the ink is set separately (`text-note`). Icons are drawn and not read, and have sizes of their own (12, 16, 20, 28). A field on a phone stays 16 px because iOS zooms the page below that; it is the one size outside the ladder.

## Where it lives

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Ladder, roles, spacing scale (4 to 64), named gaps, corners | `resources/css/type.css` |
| Three heights of shadow, next to the inks and grounds | `resources/css/colour.css` |
| Shared pieces `x-ui.page-head`, `x-ui.filter-row`, `x-ui.segmented` | `resources/css/ui.css`, `resources/views/components/ui/` |
| Tailwind's names for all of it (no value of its own) | `tailwind.config.cjs` |
| The reference page `/huisstijl` | `resources/views/huisstijl.blade.php`, reading `App\Support\DesignTokens` |
| The guide, ending in a checklist to run before a screen is called done | `docs/design-system.md` |
| The rule | R P1-1.28 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/31-p1-dagelijks-werk.md` |

## What visibly changes

Sizes, on every screen. Layout, colours and structure are untouched.

- Controls go from 14 to 15 px (buttons, fields, tabs, menu items); compact controls (`btn-sm`, chips, badges) from 12.25 or 12.5 to 13.
- Notes, column heads and help lines go from 11.5 or 12 to 13.
- Table and list text goes from 14 to 15.
- Card and section titles settle on 15/500 (were 16 or 17); page titles on 22 (were 21 to 24).
- The price on a vehicle detail goes from 30 to 26 (`display`).
- On the insights screens the two outline buttons beside the title become text actions, and the window of the activity charts is a segmented choice in one filter line with its note at the end.

Distinct text sizes per screen, measured on the rendered text of the whole page on demo data:

| Screen | 1440 before | 1440 after | 390 before | 390 after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Own stock | 10 | 5 | 10 | 5 |
| Stocklist | 11 | 5 | 9 | 6 |
| Vehicle detail | 11 | 5 | 11 | 5 |
| Bidding offers | 11 | 5 | 10 | 5 |
| Transport | 8 | 4 | 8 | 4 |
| Worklists | 10 | 4 | 8 | 4 |
| Vehicle form | 10 | 4 | 8 | 5 |
| Insights | 13 | 6 | 13 | 6 |
| Insights, activity | 10 | 5 | 10 | 5 |
| My insights | 9 | 4 | 7 | 5 |
| Settings | 6 | 4 | 5 | 4 |
| Offers, orders, relations | 7 | 4 | 7 | 4 |
| Login | 6 | 4 | 6 | 4 |

Sizes still outside the ladder in that measurement: 20 on the own-stock list and the transport window (the close mark of a notice), 21.1 on the login (the wordmark), 16 on a phone (fields).

## What is enforced

`TextRolesTest` (rule P1-1.28) fails the build on:

- a font size in a stylesheet or a view that is not a token of the ladder;
- a `font` shorthand that is not a role;
- a Tailwind size in brackets (`text-[13.5px]`), an inline `font-size`, a `leading-*` class other than `leading-none`;
- a chart word off the steps, and a rem fraction in the theme.

Two budgets in `tests/quality-ratchet.json` only shrink: `refresh_css_literal_line_heights` (85) and `legacy_css_literal_font_sizes` (14: the showroom carousel, read from across a room, and the drawing of an error number).

## Checked

- Full PHPUnit suite, PHPStan, eslint, vitest and pint on the added files, locally on the main this builds on.
- Every screen above at 1440 and 390 on demo data: no horizontal overflow, no button or chip whose text is cut, no control past the edge of the page.

## What remains

- `refresh.css` takes its sizes from the ladder but not yet whole roles: 85 rules still write their own line height, and its spacing is not on the scale.
- `resources/css/legacy/` holds the 14 literal sizes named above.
- Mails, PDFs, print sheets and the website of a dealer keep their own styling.
- Blades still use Tailwind's alias names (`text-sm`, `text-xs`); they resolve to steps of the ladder and move to role names as screens are touched.
- The spacing scale and the shadows are defined and shown on `/huisstijl`; existing screens are not moved onto them here.
- Judgement calls left as they are: on a phone the secondary button "Wagen toevoegen via chassisnummer" at the top of the vehicle form wraps over three lines at 15 px (nothing is cut); the insights tabs other than the head and filter line are restyled in the pull request that follows this one.
params.title: Text roles and the design system: six sizes, twelve roles, one reference page
